mapper.select: select * from real_object_target ot LEFT JOIN real_object ro on ot.object_id = ro.object_id where ro.node_id = #{nodeId};
select * from benchmark_target bt where evaluation_id =#{evaluationId}
select * from benchmark_range bt where evaluation_id = #{evaluationId} and model_id is not null
select * from benchmark_factor bf where evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}
select * from object_target bt where evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}
select * from object_range bt where evaluation_id = #{evaluationId} and model_id is not null
select * from object_factor bf where evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}

select bt.standard_value as benchmarkValue,ot.standard_value as realVule,ot.result_number,ot."name" from object_range ot left join benchmark_range bt on bt.evaluation_id=ot.evaluation_id and bt.model_id=ot.model_id where ot.evaluation_id =#{evaluationId} and ot.standard_value is not null

select bt.standard_value as benchmarkValue,ot.standard_value as realVule,ot.result_number,ot."name" from object_target ot left join benchmark_target bt on bt.evaluation_id=ot.evaluation_id and bt.model_id=ot.model_id where ot.evaluation_id =#{evaluationId} and ot.standard_value is not null

select bd.data_id,rbcm.id from real_benchmark_config_main rbcm inner join real_benchmark_range rbr on rbr.main_id=rbcm.id inner join benchmark_data bd on bd.node_id =rbcm.benchmark_id inner join range_data br on br.data_id=bd.data_id and br.tag_code = rbr.tag_code where rbcm.id =(select rtt.benchmark_instance_id from real_time_evaluation rte left join real_time_task rtt on rtt.id=rte.task_id where rte.id=#{evaluationId}) and rbr.name like '%' || #{text} || '%' and value-rbr.range_threshold<#{value} and value + rbr.range_threshold >#{value}

select bd.value,rbt.name,td.start_date,td.end_date,bd.data_id from target_data bd left join real_benchmark_target rbt on rbt.tag_code =bd.tag_code inner join real_benchmark_config_main rbcm on rbcm.id =rbt.main_id
inner join benchmark_data td on bd.data_id =td.data_id where main_id =#{mainId} and bd.data_id in
#{item}
order by bd.value
desc
limit 3

select bd.value,rbt.name,td.start_date,td.end_date from range_data bd left join real_benchmark_range rbt on rbt.tag_code =bd.tag_code inner join real_benchmark_config_main rbcm on rbcm.id =rbt.main_id inner join benchmark_data td on bd.data_id =td.data_id where main_id =#{mainId} and bd.data_id =#{dataId}

select bd.value,rbt.name,td.start_date,td.end_date from factor_data bd left join real_benchmark_factor rbt on rbt.tag_code =bd.tag_code inner join real_benchmark_config_main rbcm on rbcm.id =rbt.main_id inner join benchmark_data td on bd.data_id =td.data_id where main_id =#{mainId} and bd.data_id =#{dataId}
